column1: # --oldestsource on/off. With the set_options coupling, oldestsource=1 forces
# randk=0 so the LRU picker (yals_get_random_sat_clause) actually drives source
# selection instead of maintaining an unread list. A second coupling makes
# reset_os=1 force oldestsource=1, so turning oldestsource OFF requires also
# setting --reset-os=0 (otherwise the reset_os=1 default flips it back on).
#   os0 = oldestsource=0 + reset_os=0 (randk=1: top-k random picker)
#   os1 = oldestsource=1 (now the compiled default; randk auto-forced to 0: LRU)
# Caveat: os1 also consumes the init Fisher-Yates shuffle in yals_oldsrc_build,
# so the os0-vs-os1 gap blends "LRU mechanism" with a one-time reseed.
